text: Likely because they first encountered it on PBS, some Americans are unaware Connections was a BBC production: [LINK] Even less known these days (by Americans, at least) is that Connections was but one of many extraordinary educational science series that the BBC produced in the 1970's. Original footage of one of the best of these was recently rediscovered and finally made available on the web: Look Around You: Season 1 Pilot - Calcium [VIDEO] Watching it again today, it's hard to understate the positive impact this series had on British science education, and the obvious "leg up" it gave for Britain's technological prowess.

story: 50 years ago, The Electric Company used comedy to boost kids' reading skills
text: Children's TV nostalgia, eh? Back in the '80s the earliest UK TV in the morning was often a long countdown clock leading into a couple of hours of very slow-paced and somewhat haunted old schools programming [LINK] [LINK] . Now that's the stuff of memories. The whole first series/season of the early-2000s TV series Look Around You [LINK] was a parody of this programming: [VIDEO] .
